papers.title: Overnight drift in major currency pairs
papers.abstract: We document that EURUSD and USDJPY earn most of their daily return between the New York close and the London open. Using hourly quotes from 2012 to 2023, a long-overnight rule earns an annualised Sharpe ratio of 0.8 after a cost of 0.4 pips per side. On a held-out sample from 2021 to 2023 the Sharpe ratio falls to 0.5. We tried 12 entry and exit times.

papers.title: Claims reserving with gradient boosting for motor insurance
papers.abstract: We fit gradient-boosted trees to motor insurance claim triangles from four European insurers and reduce reserve error by 11% against the chain-ladder method.

papers.title: Volatility breakouts in gold futures around US data releases
papers.abstract: Gold futures move most in the 15 minutes after US inflation releases. A breakout rule that enters when the first five-minute bar exceeds 1.5 times its 20-day average range earns a Sharpe ratio of 2.6 on daily returns from 2015 to 2024, before costs. The paper does not test the rule outside this period.

papers.title: A survey of sustainable investing indices
papers.abstract: We review 140 papers on ESG index construction and summarise how providers weight environmental scores.

papers.title: Regime filters cut drawdowns in trend following on index futures
papers.abstract: A two-state volatility regime filter applied to a 50-day trend rule on S&P 500 and Euro Stoxx 50 futures cuts maximum drawdown from 31% to 18% over 2000 to 2024. Costs of one tick per trade are included. Out of sample, from 2019 to 2024, the filtered rule keeps a Sharpe ratio of 0.7 against 0.6 unfiltered. Code is at https://example.org/regime-trend.

papers.title: Existence of equilibrium prices with ambiguity-averse agents
papers.abstract: We prove that an equilibrium exists in a continuous-time economy with ambiguity-averse agents and give conditions for its uniqueness.
